data: Which of the following date ranges has the highest value for both the 'Merging Index' and 'Splitting Index'?

The question asks which date range has the highest value for both the 'Merging Index' and 'Splitting Index'. From the caption, we know this is Figure 6 showing MI and SI over a 25-topic 10-year window size. 

Looking at the graphs:

1. The Merging Index (top graph) shows its highest point around 1900-1910.
2. The Splitting Index (bottom graph) also shows its highest point around 1900-1910.

Both indices peak during the same time period, so the date range with the highest values for both is 1900-1910.
